quast-N50.title: N50 (Kbp)
quast-N50.description: N50 is the contig length such that using longer or equal length contigs produces half (50%) of the bases of the assembly (kilo base pairs)

quast-Total_length.title: Assembly Length (Mbp)
quast-Total_length.description: The total number of bases in the assembly (Mbp).

checkm-Completeness.title: Completeness
checkm-Completeness.description: Estimated completeness of genome as determined from the presence/absence of marker genes and the expected collocalization of these genes

checkm-Contamination.title: Contamination
checkm-Contamination.description: Estimated contamination of genome as determined by the presence of multi-copy marker genes and the expected collocalization of these genes
